syn-2114a04ad72cf323.text: Do not accept any obligation to hand over data from all stations without charge.
Do not accept letting Parties pick their own stations, since gaps in coverage would expose downstream areas.

syn-234f00ab94a936c3.text: Do not accept externally fixed caps on Hesmark's annual pumping in any form.
Keep decisions on Hesmark's water supply national.
Do not agree to contribute to a common compensation fund for landowners beyond Hesmark's borders.

syn-234fdb5b93636191.text: Do not accept a rule letting one Party's failure to ratify stop the agreement for everyone.
Do not accept a one-day venting rule with no exceptions for older stage designs.

syn-275773d108061efe.text: Do not accept a consensus requirement for the joint panel under any circumstances.
Do not accept any rule that allows either side to block designations.

syn-389db9278823908e.text: Do not accept a scope that would compel release of commercially licensed satellite records.
Do not accept an open-ended duty to fund training for other parties.
Keep technology transfer voluntary, with Galdovar's institutions deciding what to offer.

syn-42b84b7682851ba3.text: Do not accept a phase-in under which deferred obligations end without any support attached.
Do not accept grants for vessels and sonar tied to a single income threshold that excludes members facing real hardship.

syn-4960f63a127aa14e.text: Do not accept contributions tied to area burned in any form.
Do not accept Norcasta bearing the full cost of stations on its territory alone.
Keep the requirement that every party consent to an amendment.

syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.text: Do not accept a shared regional register for loss reports; keep reporting national.
Do not accept an automatic review cycle in which any member may table amendments.
Keep unanimous consent as the condition for any change to the rules.

syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.text: Do not accept core monitoring that relies on voluntary donations in any form.
Do not accept assessment by area burned, which could multiply Hesmark's bill after one bad season.

syn-725a99e33ed0278d.text: Do not accept a joint centre reduced to a mere data supplier; keep a regional voice on warnings.
Keep a role for national services in issuing warnings.
Do not accept removing contested readings from public view.

syn-7785b30e13e2a1b2.text: Do not accept any text that lets flood data be held back pending security review or payment.
Keep automatic, cost-free transmission of real-time readings.

syn-7f3f2e8773c0dd67.text: Do not accept any cost article that leaves island members paying for gear they did not lose.
Keep the recognition of the particular needs of small island Parties in the purpose and scope.

syn-86aff6c6fe47c152.text: Do not accept the bottom-contact fishing restrictions in any form.
Keep the rule that no permit is issued before harm to coral is properly assessed.

syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.text: Do not accept an amendment procedure that lets any one Party block change.
Keep designation of coral protection zones based on scientific surveys.

syn-8ff3af9812ba1e28.text: Do not accept recreational and aquaculture gear being brought within these rules in any form.
Keep the rules limited to registered commercial gear.

syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.text: Do not accept an open-ended halt on seabed disturbance tied to baseline surveys.
Do not accept unilaterally triggered binding arbitration in any form.
Do not accept the finance and assistance article in its present form, since it goes beyond Estova's mandate.

syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.text: Do not accept an obligation to supply hourly border data free of charge.
Do not accept alert timelines and broadcasting arrangements that override national emergency procedures.
Do not accept a fund reserved for low-lying and island Parties; every member should be eligible.

syn-aa4370fbcd7ed1b2.text: Do not accept contributions based on forest area in any form.
Do not sign a dispute article that removes final decisions from the parties themselves.

syn-b604048858d0945d.text: Do not accept a reporting system that rules out every external review.
Do not accept an outside panel having the right to visit launch sites.

syn-c1c5a08a2ea45cd0.text: Do not accept a population formula with a fixed minimum share for contributions.
Keep a firm rule that drawn stocks are restored.

syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.text: Do not accept quotas built on twenty years of historic use.
Do not accept a monitoring system in which each Party measures alone with no shared standards.
Do not accept foreign experts installing equipment on Morvane's territory without its consent.

syn-c784df49ddd8e641.text: Do not accept a mandatory five-station minimum in any form.
Keep a six-hour notice carrying the fire location, plume height and smoke forecast.

syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.text: Do not accept a rule that loads round-the-clock reporting duties onto small coastal administrations.
Do not accept contributions tied to each party's catch.

syn-d7e44bf73d9660dd.text: Do not accept cost sharing based on river length in any form.
Keep a dispute settlement article in the agreement.

syn-2114a04ad72cf323.text: Offer Kelvaro's support for the financing article as a whole as goodwill in exchange for movement on data terms.
syn-2114a04ad72cf323.quote: welcomes this financing article as a whole

syn-2114a04ad72cf323.text: Consider sharing station data on charged or limited terms, since only a duty to hand over all data free is ruled out.
syn-2114a04ad72cf323.quote: an obligation to hand over data from all stations without charge

syn-234f00ab94a936c3.text: Offer support for jointly adopted limits on fertilisers and pesticides in recharge areas as a concession to other Parties.
syn-234f00ab94a936c3.quote: backs jointly adopted standards limiting fertilisers and pesticides in recharge areas

syn-234f00ab94a936c3.text: Offer support for banning new industrial facilities and waste sites in recharge zones in return for movement elsewhere.
syn-234f00ab94a936c3.quote: supports banning new industrial facilities and waste sites in designated recharge zones

syn-234fdb5b93636191.text: Be flexible on how spent stages are made inert, provided a national regulator approves each plan in advance.
syn-234fdb5b93636191.quote: giving operators flexibility in how they make spent stages inert

syn-234fdb5b93636191.text: Offer support for reporting each launched object's orbit, mass and disposal date within thirty days.
syn-234fdb5b93636191.quote: reporting each launched object's orbit, mass and disposal date within thirty days

syn-234fdb5b93636191.text: Offer support for the target of halving new orbital debris within ten years as a sign of good faith.
syn-234fdb5b93636191.quote: the target of halving new orbital debris within ten years

syn-275773d108061efe.text: Be open to a national register with measures each Party judges appropriate, to protect fishing communities.
syn-275773d108061efe.quote: a national register with measures each Party judges appropriate

syn-275773d108061efe.text: The timing of the bottom trawling ban in designated areas could be traded, though Lumetia supports it from day one.
syn-275773d108061efe.quote: banning bottom trawling there from day one

syn-275773d108061efe.text: Offer support for biennial public reports on surveys, coral damage and measures taken.
syn-275773d108061efe.quote: welcomes biennial reports on surveys, coral damage and measures taken

syn-389db9278823908e.text: Instrument lending could be agreed if it provides for maintenance, damage and shipping costs.
syn-389db9278823908e.quote: lending instruments free of charge with no provision for maintenance, damage or the cost of shipping delicate radar

syn-389db9278823908e.text: A bounded, defined training contribution could be discussed, since only an open-ended duty is ruled out.
syn-389db9278823908e.quote: an open-ended duty to fund training for other parties

syn-389db9278823908e.text: Offer support for defined data transmission periods in return for concessions elsewhere.

syn-42b84b7682851ba3.text: Offer the Alliance's agreement to the duty to report lost gear as it stands.
syn-42b84b7682851ba3.quote: accepts the article on the duty to report lost gear as it stands

syn-42b84b7682851ba3.text: Offer support for recycling recovered gear where facilities allow and forbidding burning or dumping at sea.
syn-42b84b7682851ba3.quote: requiring recycling of recovered gear where facilities allow

syn-42b84b7682851ba3.text: The scope of free training for fisheries officers could be traded as part of a wider support package.
syn-42b84b7682851ba3.quote: free training in retrieval and record keeping for fisheries officers

syn-4960f63a127aa14e.text: Equal payments into a common fund with voluntary top-ups are preferred, but the fund's details could be negotiated.
syn-4960f63a127aa14e.quote: equal payments into a common fund, topped up by voluntary gifts

syn-4960f63a127aa14e.text: Station siting by a joint body could be reconsidered if the host consent safeguard is strengthened.
syn-4960f63a127aa14e.quote: the host consent safeguard does not go far enough

syn-4960f63a127aa14e.text: The purpose and scope article could be accepted if its reach is made clearer.
syn-4960f63a127aa14e.quote: it leaves the reach of the agreement too uncertain

syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.text: The forty-eight hour notice could be accepted in a longer or more workable form.
syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.quote: objects to the forty-eight hour notice

syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.text: The financing article could be accepted if most of the cost no longer falls on Upland Circle's fishing industry.
syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.quote: it would place most of the cost on our fishing industry

syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.text: Offer agreement to the article on cooperation in recovery operations as written.
syn-5c4b449dcf6e618d.quote: accepts the article on cooperation in recovery operations as written

syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.text: Equal shares are preferred, but the exact assessed basis could be discussed if it avoids area burned.
syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.quote: favours equal shares as the simplest and fairest basis

syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.text: Offer support for the data sharing article in return for movement on financing.
syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.quote: supports this article on data sharing

syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.text: Offer support for establishing the Joint Smoke Forecasting Centre as part of a package.
syn-6af5366ebe84eac1.quote: supports establishing the Joint Smoke Forecasting Centre

syn-725a99e33ed0278d.text: Be flexible on station funding, whether through a voluntary trust fund or equal cost shares.
syn-725a99e33ed0278d.quote: supports financing the stations through a voluntary trust fund open to outside donors

syn-725a99e33ed0278d.text: Be flexible on the scope test, whether a satellite detection test or declaration by the affected Party.
The common colour scale for simultaneous release could be discussed, though Lumetia's public knows its own scale.
syn-725a99e33ed0278d.quote: opposes simultaneous release on a common colour scale

syn-725a99e33ed0278d.text: Offer support for a binding finding by an independent three-expert panel on contested readings.
syn-725a99e33ed0278d.quote: a binding finding from an independent panel of three experts

syn-7785b30e13e2a1b2.text: A financing formula could be accepted if each member's burden reflects what it actually gains from the system.
syn-7785b30e13e2a1b2.quote: it places the burden on our members without regard to what each of them actually gains

syn-7785b30e13e2a1b2.text: Work toward redrafting the financing article, since the objection is to the article as drafted.
syn-7785b30e13e2a1b2.quote: objects to the financing article as drafted

syn-7f3f2e8773c0dd67.text: Be flexible on dispute settlement, where binding arbitration by a three-expert panel is acceptable.
syn-7f3f2e8773c0dd67.quote: supports binding arbitration by a three-expert panel

syn-7f3f2e8773c0dd67.text: Settlement through consultation and negotiation alone is also acceptable, so the dispute method can be traded.
syn-7f3f2e8773c0dd67.quote: supports settling disputes through consultation and negotiation alone

syn-86aff6c6fe47c152.text: The review interval could be discussed, though Belmora supports a five-yearly review informed by the Scientific Committee.
syn-86aff6c6fe47c152.quote: a five-yearly review informed by the Scientific Committee

syn-86aff6c6fe47c152.text: The voting rule for updating protected areas could be traded, though Belmora supports a simple majority.
syn-86aff6c6fe47c152.quote: a simple majority to update protected areas

syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.text: Reporting intervals could be traded, with publication left to each national authority as the preferred option.
syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.quote: leaving publication intervals to each national authority

syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.text: Reports every two years on coral cover, gear damage and enforcement could be offered as a compromise.
syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.quote: supports reports every two years covering coral cover, gear damage and enforcement

syn-8c5aaa49ab30d219.text: The five-year designation deadline could be discussed, though Estova welcomes it.

syn-8ff3af9812ba1e28.text: The seven day threshold for drifting gear could be discussed, though the Upland Circle favours it.
Offer support for the cost article and predictable shared funding in return for keeping the narrow scope.

syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.text: A compulsory dispute procedure could be considered if it requires each party's express consent.
syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.quote: requiring express consent before any compulsory procedure

syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.text: Offer support for the monitoring article and shared survey data in return for movement on other articles.
syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.quote: cooperation on surveys and shared data is essential

syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.text: Purpose wording could be agreed if it balances reef conservation with sustainable use and coastal community needs.
syn-96c4b7410e6a084b.quote: balancing reef conservation with sustainable use and the needs of coastal communities

syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.text: The contribution basis could be negotiated, with shares tied to population in flood-prone basins as the preferred option.
syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.quote: supports tying contributions to the population living in flood-prone basins

syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.text: Offer support for a temporary exemption for the most exposed Parties as a concession.
syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.quote: supports a temporary exemption for the most exposed Parties

syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.text: Offer agreement to the confidentiality article in full as part of a package.
syn-a5296e1f3a38aceb.quote: accepts the confidentiality article in full

syn-aa4370fbcd7ed1b2.text: Equal shares for all parties are preferred, but Arvenia could discuss the details of a simple cost formula.
syn-aa4370fbcd7ed1b2.quote: welcomes equal shares for all parties

syn-aa4370fbcd7ed1b2.text: Cost formulas other than forest area could be explored, as long as forests are not made a liability.
syn-aa4370fbcd7ed1b2.quote: a formula that makes our forests a liability

syn-b604048858d0945d.text: Offer support for the common fund for debris removal in return for concessions on compliance review.
syn-b604048858d0945d.quote: supports the article establishing a common fund

syn-b604048858d0945d.text: The form of external review is open to negotiation, provided self-reporting does not go unverified.
syn-b604048858d0945d.quote: unverified self-reporting is a line our members will not cross

syn-c1c5a08a2ea45cd0.text: Offer full support for the quality standards text as part of a package.
syn-c1c5a08a2ea45cd0.quote: fully supports the quality standards text

syn-c1c5a08a2ea45cd0.text: Other contribution formulas could be discussed if they stay within what Dalrene's budget can bear.
syn-c1c5a08a2ea45cd0.quote: it would exceed what our budget can bear

syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.text: The way reductions are shared could be negotiated, provided smaller users do not carry an equal burden.
syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.quote: objects to sharing every reduction equally

syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.text: Offer support for restricting waste sites, mining and intensive farming near recharge points.
syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.quote: supports restricting waste sites, mining and intensive farming near recharge points

syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.text: Protection of wetlands and springs before shares are assigned could be traded within the allocation package.
syn-c4d556cdb9dc6677.quote: protecting wetlands and springs before shares are assigned

syn-c784df49ddd8e641.text: Station commitments below a five-station minimum could be discussed if they fit Ostrelia's budget.
syn-c784df49ddd8e641.quote: it would bind us to costs our budget will never allow

syn-c784df49ddd8e641.text: Station numbers could be set by a middle course, avoiding both weak coverage and an open-ended funding burden.
syn-c784df49ddd8e641.quote: that invites weak coverage and an open-ended funding burden on us

syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.text: Reporting deadlines could be left to each flag state, provided every lost item is logged before the vessel next enters port.
syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.quote: provided every lost item reaches the logbook before the vessel next enters port

syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.text: Capacity support could take the form of voluntary help such as training, equipment loans and satellite monitoring.
syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.quote: voluntary help through training, equipment loans and satellite monitoring

syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.text: The dispute settlement article could be accepted if arbitration costs do not fall heavily on members with limited legal resources.
syn-d62c8400253c7fcc.quote: the cost of arbitration would fall heavily on members with very limited legal resources

syn-d7e44bf73d9660dd.text: The form of dispute settlement could be negotiated, as long as it gives a reliable way to resolve disagreements.
syn-d7e44bf73d9660dd.quote: a shared system needs a reliable way to resolve disagreements

syn-d7e44bf73d9660dd.text: Other cost-sharing bases for the shared system could be discussed, since only river length is ruled out.
syn-d7e44bf73d9660dd.quote: cost sharing based on river length
